descriere_scurta: SI Motion SCA (SN) enable (Control Unit)
descriere: Setting to enable the function "Safe Cam" (SCA).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SP modulo value (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the modulo value in degrees for rotary axes of the "Safe position" function. This modulo value is taken into account when safely referencing as well as when transferring the safe position via PROFIsafe when the absolute position is enabled. The value should be set, so that it is precisely at 2^n revolutions, so that when the range that can be represented (+/- 2048) overflows, this does not cause the position actual value to jump. The modulo function is deactivated for a value = 0.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion function specification (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the function specification for the safe motion monitoring.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion function specification (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the function configuration for the safe motion monitoring functions.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion behavior during pulse suppression (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the behavior of safety functions and their feedback during pulse suppression in encoderless operation.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion clock-cycle synchronous PROFIBUS master
descriere: Setting for clock cycle synchronous communication between PROFIdrive controller and Control Unit. The parameter is only relevant, if the safety-relevant motion monitoring functions integrated in the drive have been enabled (p9601.2 =1 ). If a PROFIdrive controller exchanges process data in clock cycle synchronism with the Control Unit, then p9510 must be set to 1. This also applies if the drive itself does not exchange process data in clock cycle synchronism. Examples for clock cycle synchronous communication: - clock-cycle synchronous control for the motion control (e.g. SIMOTION). - clock-cycle synchronous PROFIsafe master (e.g. SIMATIC S7-400F).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion actual value sensing cycle clock (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the clock cycle time of the actual value sensing for safe motion monitoring. Setting criteria if the motion monitoring functions are executed with an encoder. - A slower clock cycle time reduces the maximum permissible velocity - however, it ensures a lower load of the Control Unit for safe actual value sensing. - The maximum permissible velocity which, when exceeded, can mean that errors occur during safe actual value sensing, is displayed in r9730. - The isochronous PROFIBUS clock cycle is used as a clock cycle time for actual value sensing with a setting of 0 ms; the setting is 1 ms if isochronous operation is not being used.

descriere_scurta: Select SI Motion safety functions without selection (CU)
descriere: Sets the safety functions without selection. The safety functions without selection are enabled with p9601.5/p9801.5. Using this parameter, the individual motion monitoring functions can then be selected (e.g. SLS, SDI positive, SDI negative), which should then be permanently selected.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion non safety-relevant measuring steps POS1 (CU)
descriere: Sets the non safety-relevant measuring steps of position value POS1. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Control Unit must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion absolute encoder linear measuring steps (CU)
descriere: Sets the resolution of the absolute position for a linear absolute encoder. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Control Unit must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion encoder coarse position value config (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the encoder configuration for the redundant coarse position value. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Control Unit must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion encoder configuration safety functions (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the configuration for the encoder and position actual value. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Control Unit must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion linear encoder grid division (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the grid division for a linear encoder. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Control Unit must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion encoder pulses per revolution (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the number of encoder pulses per revolution for rotary encoders. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Control Unit must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion fine resolution G1_XIST1 (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the fine resolution for G1_XIST1 in bits. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Control Unit must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion spindle pitch (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the gear ratio between the encoder and load in mm/revolution for a linear axis with rotary encoder.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion redundant coarse pos. value valid bits (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the number of valid bits of the redundant coarse position value. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Control Unit must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion Redundant coarse pos. value fine resolution bits (CU)
descriere: Sets the number of valid bits for the fine resolution of the redundant coarse position value. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Control Unit must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion Redundant coarse pos. value relevant bits (CU)
descriere: Sets the number of relevant bits for the redundant coarse position value. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Control Unit must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion encoder assignment second channel
descriere: Sets the number of the encoder, which is used by the second channel for safe motion monitoring functions.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion Gx_XIST1 coarse pos. safe most significant bit (CU)
descriere: Sets the bit number for the safe most significant bit (MSB) of the Gx_XIST1 coarse position. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Control Unit must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion standstill tolerance (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the tolerance for the function "Safe Operating Stop" (SOS).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SLS setpoint velocity limiting (Control Unit)
descriere: This is an evaluation factor to define the setpoint limit from the selected actual speed limit. The active SLS limit value is evaluated with this factor and is made available as setpoint limit in r9733.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SCA (SN) tolerance (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the tolerance for the function "Safe Cam" (SCA). Within this tolerance, both monitoring channels may signal different signal states of the same safe cam.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion encoder comparison algorithm (CU)
descriere: Sets the comparison algorithm for the encoder position monitoring functions. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Control Unit must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion act val comparison tol (crosswise) (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the tolerance for the crosswise data comparison of the actual position between the two monitoring channels.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion gearbox switching position tolerance factor (CU)
descriere: Sets the factor to increase the tolerance for the crosswise data comparison of the actual position between the two monitoring channels while the gearbox stage is being switched over. This factor is effective when actual value synchronization is activated and when deactivated. Depending on the following tolerance, the following is obtained: - actual value synchronization activated: p9549 * p9543 - actual value synchronization deactivated: p9542 * p9543

descriere_scurta: SI Motion actual value comparison tolerance (referencing) (CU)
descriere: Sets the tolerance for checking the actual values. For an incremental encoder, the actual values are checked after referencing; for an absolute encoder, when switching on.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SSM (SGA n < nx) filter time (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the filter time for the SSM feedback signal to detect standstill.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SSM (SGA n < nx) velocity limit (CU)
descriere: Sets the velocity limit for the SSM feedback signal to detect standstill (n < nx). When this limit value is undershot, the signal "SSM feedback signal active" (SGA n < n_x) is set. For p9568 = 0, the value in p9546 is also applicable for the function "SAM".

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SSM (SGA n < nx) velocity hysteresis (CU)
descriere: Sets the velocity hysteresis for the SSM feedback signal to detect standstill (n < nx).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SAM actual velocity tolerance (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the velocity tolerance for the "SAM" function.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion slip velocity tolerance (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the velocity tolerance that is used for a 2-encoder system in crosswise comparison between the two monitoring channels.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SGE changeover tolerance time (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the tolerance time for the changeover of the safety-related inputs (SGE).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SLS(SG) changeover/SOS (SBH) delay time (CU)
descriere: Sets the delay time for the SLS changeover and for the activation of SOS for the functions "Safely-Limited Speed" (SLS) and "Safe operating stop" (SOS). When transitioning from a higher to a lower safely-limited speed level, and when activating safe operating stop (SOS), within this delay time, the "old" speed level remains active. This delay is also applicable when activating SLS from the state "SOS and SLS inactive" and activating SOS from the state "SOS inactive".

descriere_scurta: SI Motion transition time STOP C to SOS (SBH) (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the transition time from STOP C to "Safe Operating Stop" (SOS).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion transition time STOP D to SOS (SBH) (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the transition time from STOP D to "Safe Operating Stop" (SOS).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion transition time STOP E to SOS (SBH) (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the transition time from STOP E to "Safe Operating Stop" (SOS).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion transition time STOP F to STOP B (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the transition time from STOP F to STOP B.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion STOP A delay time (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the delay time for STOP A after STOP B.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion STO test time (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the time after which STO must be active when initiating the test stop.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion acceptance test mode time limit (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the maximum time for the acceptance test mode. If the acceptance test mode takes longer than the selected time limit, then the mode is automatically terminated.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion forced checking procedure timer (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the time interval for carrying out the forced checking procedure and testing the safety motion monitoring functions integrated in the drives. Within the parameterized time, the safety functions must have been tested at least once (including de-selection of the "STO" function). This monitoring time is reset each time the test is carried out. The signal source to initiate the forced checking procedure is set in p9705.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion STO shutdown velocity (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the shutdown velocity for activating STO. Below this velocity "standstill" is assumed and for STOP B / SS1, STO is selected.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SLS (SG) stop response (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the stop response for the function "Safely-Limited Speed" (SLS). This setting applies for all SLS limit values. An input value of less than 5 signifies personnel protection, from 10 and upwards, machine protection. This parameter can only be used for SINUMERIK Safety Integrated. For motion monitoring functions integrated in the drive, only a value of 5 is permissible. Other settings result in the safety message C01711/C30711 with message value 44.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SDI tolerance (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the tolerance for the function "Safe motion direction" (SDI). This motion in the monitored direction is still permissible before safety message C01716 is initiated.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SDI delay time (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the delay time for the function "Safe motion direction" (SDI). After selecting the SDI function, then for a maximum of this time, motion in the monitored direction is permissible. This time can therefore be used for braking any motion.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SDI stop response (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the stop response for the function "Safe motion direction" (SDI). This setting applies to both directions of motion.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion switchover velocity to SOS (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the switch over velocity to SOS. Below this velocity limit, for a transition to SOS, standstill (zero velocity ) is assumed. The transition times from STOP C, D, E and the delay time when selecting SOS are canceled if this velocity threshold is fallen below. The wait time from p9569 is started, and after it has expired, SOS is active. For a STOP C, this switchover velocity is the only criterion for prematurely activating an SOS. In the other cases mentioned here, it must first have been signaled that the axis had correctly braked.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SAM velocity limit (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the velocity tolerance limit for the "SAM" function. SAM is de-activated once the set velocity limit has been undershot.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion acceptance test mode (Control Unit)
descriere: Setting to select and de-select the acceptance test mode.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion reference position (Control Unit)
descriere: The reference position entered in this parameter, is used as safe absolute position when setting p9573. If errors are identified when performing the plausibility checks, then message C01711 is output with message value 1003

descriere_scurta: SI Motion accept reference position (Control Unit)
descriere: The safe absolute position is rejected or newly set using this parameter. If errors are identified when performing the plausibility checks, then message C1711 is output with message value 1003

descriere_scurta: SI Motion safe position scaling (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the scaling factor to transfer the safe position via PROFIsafe in the 16-bit notation.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion acceptance test SLP (SE) (Control Unit)
descriere: Setting to select and de-select the acceptance test for SLP (SE).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SLP delay time (Control Unit)
descriere: Setting the delay time: -between selecting and activating the "Safety-limited Position" (SLP) function -when changing between the two active SLP ranges, if the new range is not completely contained in the old range.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion STO delay bus failure (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the delay time after which STO is executed when the bus fails.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion brake ramp reference value (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the reference value to define the brake ramp. The rate of rise of the brake ramp depends upon p9581 (reference value) and p9583 (monitoring time).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion brake ramp delay time (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the delay time for monitoring the brake ramp. Monitoring of the brake ramp starts once the delay time has elapsed.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion brake ramp monitoring time (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the monitoring time to define the brake ramp. The rate of rise of the brake ramp depends upon p9581 (reference value) and p9583 (monitoring time).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion actual value sensing sensorless fault tolerance (CU)
descriere: Sets the tolerance of the plausibility monitoring of the current and voltage angle. A higher value results in a higher degree of ruggedness when reversing at low speeds, as well as in the field weakening range for load steps. An increase is advantageous, if the current or voltage at the motor become small.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion actual value sensing sensorless filter time (CU)
descriere: Sets the filter time for smoothing the actual value with sensorless actual value sensing.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion actual value sensing sensorless minimum current (CU)
descriere: Sets the minimum current for encoderless actual value sensing referred to 1 A (i.e. 1 % = 10 mA). - The value must be increased if C01711 has occurred with message value 1042. - The value must be decreased if C01711 has occurred with message value 1041. For synchronous motors, the following condition must be fulfilled: |p0305 x p9783| >= p9588 x 1.2

descriere_scurta: SI Motion act. value sensing sensorless acceleration limit (CU)
descriere: Sets the acceleration limit to filter velocity fluctuations. If this percentage value is increased, when accelerating, velocity peaks that do not reflect the real velocity characteristic can occur. If this value is decreased, and this dampens the velocity peaks when accelerating. - The value must be increased if C01711 with message value 1043 has occurred. - The value must be lowered if acceleration procedures have led to an excessive Safety actual velocity.

descriere_scurta: SI enable functions integrated in the drive (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the enable signals for the safety functions integrated in the drive and the type of selection on the Control Unit. Not all of the settings listed below will be permissible, depending on the Control Unit and Motor Module or Power Module being used: 0000 hex: Safety functions integrated in the drive inhibited (no safety function). 0001 hex: Basic functions are enabled via onboard terminals (permissible for r9771.0 = 1). 0004 hex: Extended functions via Terminal Module 54F (TM54F) have been enabled (permissible for r9771.5 = 1). 0005 hex: Extended functions via Terminal Module 54F (TM54F) and the basic functions via onboard terminals have been enabled (permissible for r9771.5 = 1). 0008 hex: Basic functions are enabled via PROFIsafe (permissible for r9771.6 = 1). 0009 hex: Basic functions are enabled via PROFIsafe onboard terminals (permissible for r9771.6 = 1). 000C hex: Extended functions are enabled via PROFIsafe (permissible for r9771.4 = 1). 000D hex: Extended functions are enabled via PROFIsafe and basic functions via onboard terminals (permissible for r9771.4 = 1). 0014 hex: Extended functions via integrated F-DI/F-DO have been enabled. 0024 hex: Extended functions without selection are enabled (permissible for r9771.16 = 1). 0025 hex: Extended functions without selection and basic functions via onboard terminals are enabled (permissible for r9771.16 = 1).

descriere_scurta: SI enable Safe Brake Control (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the enable signal for the function "Safe Brake Control" (SBC) on the Control Unit.

descriere_scurta: SI PROFIsafe address (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the PROFIsafe address for the Control Unit.

descriere_scurta: SI PROFIsafe telegram selection (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the PROFIsafe telegram number for the Control Unit.

descriere_scurta: SI HLA shutoff valve feedback signal contact configuration (CU)
descriere: Sets the feedback signal contacts of the shutoff valve to be monitored. The sensors for the feedback signal of the shutoff valves are connected via X281/X282.

descriere_scurta: SI SGE changeover discrepancy time (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the discrepancy time to change over the safety-related inputs (SGE) on the Control Unit. An SGE changeover is not effective simultaneously due to the different runtimes in the two monitoring channels. After an SGE changeover, dynamic data is not subject to a crosswise data comparison during this discrepancy time.

descriere_scurta: SI STO/SS1 debounce time (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the debounce time for the failsafe digital inputs used to control STO/SS1.

descriere_scurta: SI Safe Stop 1 delay time (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the delay time for STO for the function "Safe Stop 1" (SS1) on the Control Unit to brake along the OFF3 down ramp (p1135).

descriere_scurta: SI Safe Stop 1 drive-based braking response
descriere: Sets the drive-based braking response for the "Safe Stop 1" (SS1) function.

descriere_scurta: SI transition time STOP F to STOP A (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the transition period from STOP F to STOP A on the Control Unit.

descriere_scurta: SI forced checking procedure timer
descriere: Sets the time interval for carrying out the forced checking procedure and testing the Safety shutdown paths. Within the parameterized time, STO must have been de-selected at least once. The monitoring time is reset each time that STO is de-selected.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion bus failure STO/SH delay time (CU)
descriere: Sets the delay time for STO after bus failure on the Control Unit (e.g. used for ESR).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion copy function
descriere: Setting to start the required copy function. After starting, the appropriate parameters are copied from the Control Unit to the Hydraulic Module. Once copying is complete, the parameter is automatically reset to zero.

descriere_scurta: Acknowledge SI motion data change
descriere: Setting to transfer the reference checksums from the associated actual checksums after changes (SI parameters, hardware). After transferring the reference checksums, parameters are automatically reset to zero.

descriere_scurta: SI Acknowledge component replacement
descriere: Setting to acknowledge that a component has been replaced. By writing 29 to this parameter, the unique identifier of a safety-relevant component is transferred into the drive parameterization.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion: Test stop signal source
descriere: Sets the signal source for the test stop of the safety-relevant motion monitoring functions.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion user agreement selection/de-selection
descriere: Setting to select and de-select the user agreement.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion user agreement selection/de-selection MM
descriere: Setting to select and de-select the user agreement on the Motor Module/Hydraulic Module.

descriere_scurta: SI message cases counter
descriere: Number of safety messages that have occurred since the last reset.

descriere_scurta: SI password input
descriere: Enters the Safety Integrated password.

descriere_scurta: SI password new
descriere: Enters a new Safety Integrated password.

descriere_scurta: SI password acknowledgement
descriere: Acknowledges the new Safety Integrated password.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion act. value sensing sensorless synchr. motor I_inject
descriere: Sets the additional field-generating current for synchronous motors with sensorless actual value sensing. The set value is referred to p0305. This parameter ensures a "base load" for the motor. The value must fulfill the following condition: |p0305 x p9783| >= p9588 x 1.2

descriere_scurta: SI reference checksum SI parameters (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the checksum for the checked Safety Integrated parameters on the Control Unit (reference checksum).

descriere_scurta: SI enable functions integrated in the drive (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the enable signals for the safety functions integrated in the drive and the type of selection on the Hydraulic Module. The following settings are permitted: 0000 hex: Safety functions integrated in the drive inhibited (no safety function). 0001 hex: Basic functions are enabled via onboard terminals (permissible for r9871.0 = 1). 0004 hex: Extended functions via Terminal Module 54F (TM54F) have been enabled (permissible for r9871.5 = 1). 0005 hex: Extended functions via Terminal Module 54F (TM54F) and the basic functions via onboard terminals have been enabled (permissible for r9871.5 = 1). 0008 hex: Basic functions are enabled via PROFIsafe (permissible for r9871.6 = 1). 0009 hex: Basic functions are enabled via PROFIsafe onboard terminals (permissible for r9871.6 = 1). 000C hex: Extended functions are enabled via PROFIsafe (permissible for r9871.4 = 1). 000D hex: Extended functions are enabled via PROFIsafe and basic functions via onboard terminals (permissible for r9871.4 = 1). 0024 hex: Extended functions without selection are enabled (permissible for r9871.16 = 1). 0025 hex: Extended functions without selection and basic functions via onboard terminals are enabled (permissible for r9871.16 = 1).

descriere: Sets the time to open the motor holding brake. After controlling the holding brake (opens), the speed/velocity setpoint remains at zero for this time. After this, the speed/velocity setpoint is enabled.

descriere_scurta: SI PROFIsafe address (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the PROFIsafe address of the Motor Module/Hydraulic module.

descriere_scurta: SI PROFIsafe telegram selection (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the PROFIsafe telegram number for the Hydraulic Module.

descriere_scurta: SI Safe Brake Adapter signal source (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the signal source for Safe Brake Adapter (SBA). This defines via which digital input the Safe Brake Adapter feedback signal is read-in (SBA_DIAG). p9621/p9821 = 0: There is no Safe Brake Control (SBC) with Safe Brake Adapter (SBA) available. p9621/p9821 = r0722.x (x = 0, 1 ... 7) Safe Brake Adapter and Booksize unit (no Communication Interface Module (CIM)). p9621/p9821 = r9872.3 Safe Brake Adapter and Chassis unit (CIM).

descriere_scurta: SI HLA shutoff valve feedback signal contact configuration (MM)
descriere: Sets the feedback signal contacts of the shutoff valve to be monitored. The sensors for the feedback signal of the shutoff valves are connected via X281/X282.

descriere_scurta: SI SGE changeover discrepancy time (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the discrepancy time to change over the safety-related inputs (SGE) on the Motor Module/Hydraulic Module. An SGE changeover is not effective simultaneously due to the different runtimes in the two monitoring channels. After an SGE changeover, dynamic data is not subject to a crosswise data comparison during this discrepancy time.

descriere_scurta: SI STO/SS1 debounce time (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the debounce time for the STO terminal of the Hydraulic Module.

descriere_scurta: SI Safe Stop 1 delay time (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the delay time for STO for the function "Safe Stop 1" (SS1) on the Hydraulic Module to brake along the OFF3 down ramp (p1135).

descriere_scurta: SI transition time STOP F to STOP A (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the transition period from STOP F to STOP A on the Motor Module/Hydraulic Module.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion bus failure STO delay time (MM)
descriere: Sets the delay time for STO after bus failure on the Motor Module/Hydraulic Module (e.g. used for ESR).

descriere_scurta: SI reference checksum SI parameters (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the checksum for the checked Safety Integrated parameters on the Motor Module/Hydraulic Module (reference checksum).
